uniprot.function: Involved in endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress-mediated apoptosis through human Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) signaling pathway. Localizes to the host ER, leading to ER stress, disruption of intracellular Ca(2+) homeostasis and increase of nitric oxide (NO) and reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels. Stress response results in caspase-8 activation and apoptosis of macrophage cells. Apoptosis may lead to dissemination of the bacteria, thereby spreading the disease
